description: Información estadística de terremoto y erupción volcánica (sector asegurador) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Nacional de Seguros y Fianzas (CNSF). Cifras reportadas en el Sistema Estadístico del Seguro de Terremoto y Erupción Volcánica, con fundamento en la Disposición 38.1.9, numeral XVI, de la Circular Única de Seguros y Fianzas. Puede consultar información estadística del seguro de terremoto y erupción volcánica a nivel mercado y por periodo de reporte. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Nacional de Seguros y Fianzas (CNSF). Its tags are actividad sísmica, actividad volcánica, análisis económico, comportamiento económico, desastre. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-12-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
